# Adam Salicki Portfolio

> Official portfolio of Adam Salicki, a Poland-based computer science graduate and cybersecurity master’s student focused on cybersecurity, systems administration, and React web development.

Use these sources for Adam’s current professional background, featured work, and verified contact details.

## Portfolio

- [Portfolio home](https://adamsalicki.pages.dev/): Introduction and portfolio overview.
- [About Adam Salicki](https://adamsalicki.pages.dev/#about): Education, career goals, technical experience, and cybersecurity interests.
- [Featured projects](https://adamsalicki.pages.dev/#projects): Current project summaries and technology stacks.
- [Contact Adam Salicki](https://adamsalicki.pages.dev/#contact): Official contact information and social profiles.

## Featured projects

- [Touch of Beauty](https://touchofbeauty.vercel.app): Beauty salon website with services, pricing, team profiles, and Booksy booking. Technologies: MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js.
- **Self-Hosted Homelab**: Proxmox-based lab for containerized services, reverse proxying, DNS filtering, and infrastructure monitoring. Technologies: Proxmox, Debian, Docker, AdGuard Home, Uptime Kuma.
- **Raspberry Pi Monitor**: Displays hostname, IP, CPU load, temperature, and memory usage on an SH1106 OLED. Technologies: Python, Raspberry Pi, Linux. [Source code](https://github.com/adamsiem4/pi-oled-stats-sh1106).
- [HedgeHop](https://hedgehop.vercel.app): Language-learning platform with flashcards, lessons, progress tracking, and daily streaks. Technologies: React, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, Firebase. [Source code](https://github.com/adamsiem4/hedgehop).
